domain.title: Let the assistant use {{host}}?
domain.description: The assistant wants to use the browser pane on a site you have not approved yet.
domain.urlHint: Check the whole address, including anything after the ?. Addresses can carry information out of your conversation.

wants.browser_screenshot: take a picture of this page
wants.browser_press: press a key on this page
wants.browser_select: choose an option on this page

domain.onceHint: Ends when the assistant moves to a different site, or after 15 minutes.
domain.alwaysHint: Saved. You can remove it in Settings > Agent tools.
domain.warning: The assistant can read everything on the page, and text on a page can try to mislead it.

settings.title: Browser
settings.enabled: Let the assistant use the browser pane
settings.enabledDesc: Adds tools to open pages, read them and, with your approval, click and type in the built-in browser pane. You see the same pane. Each site asks the first time; local and private-network addresses are never opened.
settings.maxActionsDesc: Clicks, keystrokes and selections one run may make before it has to stop.
settings.rulesDesc: Sites you allowed always, or blocked. A rule for example.com covers that site only; *.example.com covers its subdomains.
settings.empty: No saved rules yet. A site appears here when you choose Always allow or Never allow.
settings.addPrivate: Allow this to be a local or private-network address (for a dev server)
